title: Skin Care for Amritsar Weather: A Routine for Dry Summers, Humid Monsoons and Foggy Winters
ex: Scorching dry summers, a sticky monsoon and cold, foggy winters: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Amritsar.
rt: Skin Care for Amritsar Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Amritsar weather: sun care for hot dry summers, fewer layers in the monsoon and a richer routine for cold, foggy Punjab winters and heaters.
quick: Amritsar is very hot and dry from April to June, humid from July to September and cold and foggy from December to February. Use a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, a thin gel moisturiser in the warm months, and a richer night cream, lip balm and warm baths in winter.
facts: Amritsar is on the inland Punjab plains, far from the sea
April to June is very hot and dry with hot winds and dust
The monsoon usually runs July to September
December and January bring dense fog and cold mornings and nights
